summary: Backend-only regression verification for Phase 2C Wave 2/3 unit tests. Ran the 3 new test files (test_phase2c_chat_router_wave3.py, test_phase2c_cto_projects_router_wave2.py, test_phase2c_local_tools_wave2.py) individually and the pre-existing wave-1 suite as sanity. All targets pass with zero failures. No production code changes needed.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking warnings: several tests in cto_projects wave2 leave background asyncio coroutines (agent_brain/agent_recent/agent_structure/agent_stack/agent_graph) un-awaited when the warm-agents dispatcher is triggered, and one test in local_tools_wave2 leaves a Process.communicate coroutine dangling causing an 'Event loop is closed' shutdown message. Tests pass but the fixture teardown could cancel/await these to silence the noise.
backend/routers/chat.py still uses Pydantic v1 style @validator decorators (deprecation warnings on ChatBody.prompt and task_type). Should migrate to @field_validator before Pydantic V3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2C wave-3 chat + wave-2 cto_projects + wave-2 local_tools unit tests are all green (75/75 new, 323/323 wave-1 sanity). Only style/warning items remain (pydantic v1 validators, dangling coroutines in a couple of tests). No production regressions.
